import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a comprehensive dashboard-style visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Top left: Sales by Product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(v, i, f' ${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top right: Sales by Customer Age Group and Payment Method
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex(age_order)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, width=0.8, color=sns.color_palette("Set2"))
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Payment Method', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax2.set_xticklabels(ax2.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# 3. Bottom left: Takeaway vs Dine-in Distribution
takeaway_data = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({'total': 'sum', 'date': 'count'})
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(takeaway_data['total'], 
                                     labels=takeaway_labels,
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     startangle=90,
                                     colors=['#FF9999', '#66B2FF'],
                                     explode=(0.05, 0.05),
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 11, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')

# 4. Bottom right: Average Transaction Value by Size
size_avg = df.groupby('size')['total'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
size_order = ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small']
size_avg_ordered = size_avg.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in size_avg.index])
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
bars4 = ax4.bar(range(len(size_avg_ordered)), size_avg_ordered.values, 
                color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'], 
                edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(size_avg_ordered)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(size_avg_ordered.index, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Product Size', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, (bar, val) in enumerate(zip(bars4, size_avg_ordered.values)):
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, val, f'${val:.2f}', 
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
